landing.docTitle: jooob — what employers are actually hiring for
landing.docDescription: A free job site built from what employers actually publish. Search by the tools and concepts you know, see what companies are really like, and post your own roles for nothing.
landing.heading: What employers are actually hiring for.
landing.lede: Not what a job board says is popular — what is written in the adverts themselves. Every posting is read, the tools and concepts in it are named, and the whole lot is counted, so you can see the market instead of scrolling through it.

donate.docDescription: jooob is free, and stays free.
donate.eyebrow: No ads, no listing fee, no subscription
donate.heading: Keep jooob alive.
donate.lede: If jooob has been useful to you, this is where you can help.
donate.warnBody: Each address below belongs to one chain. A token sent on the wrong chain cannot be recovered by anyone, including us.
donate.shareBody: Tell someone the site exists. A person who finds a job through it is worth more to this project than the bill is.

login.heading: Sign in to your account
login.hiringBody: You need to sign in so we know the postings are really yours.

employer.heading: Post your jobs where people are actually looking.
employer.lede: Add your own roles and they appear beside everything we collect — matched against the skills each person says they have.
employer.companiesBody: Claim the company you hire for. Approval takes a little while to review.
employer.remote: This role can be done remotely
employer.postingsEmpty: Nothing yet. Add a company first, then publish your first posting.
